t: The Prysmian 6243BH 1.5mm² low smoke and fume 3-core and earth cable meets enhanced safety requirements for sensitive installations including hospitals, schools and care facilities. This harmonised cable reduces toxic gases and corrosive fumes during fire conditions, protecting building occupants and infrastructure. The 50-metre drum suits smaller projects and refurbishment work without excess waste. Solid copper core wire maintains rigidity for straightforward installation, whilst the white PVC sheath with low-smoke formulation resists damage and performs reliably across -25 to 90°C. The flat profile simplifies routing through tight spaces. Rated to 300/500V, this cable meets modern fire safety standards for critical environments requiring enhanced fire performance.
b: Brown, Black & Grey Cores with Bare Earth
